acceptance_criteria: **Desktop fidelity.** Each of the 13 desktop boards passes at 1440: report.json has `pass: true`, `scores.coverageWithExceptions` = 100 and `scores.visual` ≥ 90. The boards are SCR-02-desktop and SCR-02-desktop-{ready, processing, waiting, verified, issue, cancelled, owner-needed, setup-needed, permission, effect-uncertain, awaiting-reconciliation, history}, each with the URL and cookie from the fixture table. — verify, per board:

**Phone fidelity.** The same holds for the 13 `SCR-02-mobile*` boards at `--width 390`, with `--out …/SCR-02-mobile-<state>-390`. — verify: the same command shape, exit 0, and the rows in `scores.txt`.

**Exceptions are limited and explained.** Every entry in `delivery/features/F-14/fidelity-exceptions.json` has `role`, `name`, `reason` and `approved_by` (`"builder proposal, pending design engineer"` until confirmed). Each falls into one of these categories:

**Phone back link in the frame slot.** At 390, /work/W-1701, /work/W-1099 and the loading state show the phone bar link "← Queue" to /my-work in place of Menu. /work/W-1705/history shows "← Invoice" to /work/W-1705. A history page with no `back_label` shows "← Work item". `main` contains no back link of its own. At 1440 the phone bar is not shown. — verify: e2e at both widths, plus a component test rendered inside `AppShell`.

**Titles.** The item `h1` uses `.shell-title`, with a computed `font-size` of 40px at 1440 and the board's phone size at 390. There is one `h1` per page, including no access. — verify: e2e reading `getComputedStyle`.

**The six facts (A-WORKITEM) still hold.** The F-03 facts tests pass unchanged on W-1004: six boxes, Earned with times, Sent "Not yet", Receipt recorded "Unknown", Verified "Not yet", the Paid note, and never blank or 0. On W-1705 the visible fact details are the board's ("v2", "Ada", "10:47", …), and each box's accessible text still contains its contract status word. — verify: existing and new component tests.

**Unknown wins over presentation.** A fixture whose `sent` is `unknown` but whose `presentation.facts.sent` is "Delivered" shows "Unknown" for Sent. W-1710's Sent reads "Unknown". — verify: component test with a crafted fixture.
**Stations.**

**Header from the contract.** W-1701 shows the breadcrumb (My work / Prepare an invoice / INV-0412), the title, the state tag `STATE_TAGS.waiting`, and "Started by Tunde Bello (PMO) · Mon 10 Nov 14:05 · revision 2", all from `started_by`, `started_at` and `revision`. A fixture without `started_by` shows only "revision N". — verify: component test.
**Decision summary, right person only.**
**The agent card never offers a decision.**
**State panels.** Each state fixture shows its board's panel heading and body:
**Navigation links only, and safe.**
**Read only, no effects.**

**No role guesses.** W-1708 and W-1709 render identically for the stubbed personas finance_lead and pm. Their text comes from the record, not from `me.roles`. — verify: a component test comparing `container.innerHTML` under both E-ME stubs.
**No access, signed out and error states (F-03 AC 10 to 12 hold).**
**Mock fixtures are valid and proposals are contained.**
**History (A-HISTORY) on the boards.**

**Updates (D-UPDATES) unchanged.** W-1703 (agent working) re-reads every 5 s while visible and stops when hidden. The other W-17xx items never poll. — verify: the existing polling tests, plus one fake-timer test on W-1703.
**Accessibility at both widths.** Every W-17xx URL, /work/W-1099 and /work/W-1705/history has:

**Tokens only.** `grep -nE "#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b|rgba?\(|hsl\(" frontend/src/features/work-item/work-item.css` returns nothing. Colours, font families, radii and spacing come from `var(--…)` tokens. — verify: the command.
**F-09 seams.**

**Existing suites pass.** `tests/work-item.test.tsx`, `tests/decide*.test.tsx`, `tests/my-work*.test.tsx`, `tests/shell.test.tsx`, `e2e/work-item.spec.ts` and `e2e/decide.spec.ts` pass. Every changed assertion in the F-03 tests is listed in build.md with its reason; only the visible wording and wrappers move, not the behaviour. The F-03 acceptance criteria in `delivery/features/F-03/feature.json` still hold. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh` and build.md.

risk.rationale: Medium. Many states and two viewports on a page that F-03, F-04, F-06 and F-09 build on, so a regression would be visible but is easy to verify with the fidelity tool, the existing tests and axe. Surfaces are `ui` only: no API, auth, security, data or payment change, and the existing role and permission states (permission, owner-needed) must keep rendering from `allowed_actions` and the API, not from role guesses. Precedent F-02 round 3 (delivery/features/F-02/round-3/build.md) shows the pattern and its limits: frame-owned differences (phone top bar) can hold scores under 90, and those need design-engineer exceptions rather than hacks.

findings.summary: On phones, items with no `presentation` (every live item) render the Overview/History tabs after the page content instead of under the header as F-03 did. `WorkItemView.tsx:161` (`{phone && !(tab === 'history' && view) && tabs}`) puts the tabs at the bottom, so History is reached by scrolling to the end of the overview, and Overview on the history tab sits below the list. Expected: tabs stay under the header for items without a board, and move only on board pages.

On the phone history board (`counts` present) the "Rows per page" control is not rendered at all, and neither are "Showing N" and "As of" (`WorkItemHistory.tsx:195,234`: `!board && !side`). The spec says the rows-per-page control and Show more stay as F-03 requires. Only fixtures carry `history_counts`, so live pages are unaffected. Putting the select in `work-sr` would leave a focusable invisible control, so the board owner should decide where it goes (for example a visible small control) and record an exception.

On phones `presentation.phone.title` replaces the contract `title` in the h1, and the header sub-line shows "ref · revision N" instead of the contract started line (`WorkItemView.tsx:34,45-52`), so `started_by` and `started_at` are absent on phones even for screen readers. Rule 1 says contract fields come first. Only fixtures are affected. Keep the contract title and started line in a `work-sr` span, or record both as exceptions.

Note for F-06: `NextStep` sits inside a `work-sr` wrapper (`WorkItemOverview.tsx:707-709`). A "See all exceptions" link added there would be focusable but invisible. F-06 must either draw it visibly or keep it out of that wrapper. Not a defect today (no control inside).

History has no entry point from any overview. D-41 removed the Overview/History tabs because the overview boards do not draw them, and the only `/history` link left in `frontend/src/features/work-item/WorkItemView.tsx:100` is the tab on the history page itself. Walked W-1701, W-1705 and W-1710 at both widths. The links on those pages are the shell, "MY WORK", the panel links and the decision link, and none go to History. A reviewer or Finance Lead cannot reach the audit trail from the item. Expected: the design engineer picks where the link goes (for example a line in the started-by row or in the state panel), and the owner of that placement draws it. F-06's next-step link slot is not a substitute.

On the phone awaiting-reconciliation page (W-1711 at 390) the pinned bar room (`bar_slot`) shows as an empty white strip across the foot of the screen, with no control. Until F-09 mounts "Record and continue" it looks like a rendering fault, and the item has no action. Hide the room until the slot has content, or keep it only once F-09 is merged. Desktop W-1711 shows no right column for the same reason, so a Finance Lead can read that a person must confirm but cannot do it.

The station list is a focusable scroll region ("01 Milestone evidence ..." takes a Tab stop on phone, and the Stations section does at 1440). It has no accessible name, so a keyboard user gets an unlabelled stop. Give it `aria-label="Stations"` or remove the tab stop if nothing scrolls.

Fact boxes lose the board's attention tint when the presentation gives a detail for a `not_yet` fact. Expected (boards): SCR-02-desktop/mobile-awaiting-reconciliation tint RECEIPT "Not found" amber (#6E4700 on the amber fill, like SENT "Unknown"). SCR-02-desktop/mobile-issue tint SENT "Not yet" red (#9A2F10 on the red fill, like REVIEWED "Waiting" on the default board). Actual: plain white box with grey #626B6F text (reports list these as "text colour #6E4700/#9A2F10 on the board, #626B6F on the page"). Cause: `factClass` keys only on status, and `not_yet` maps to bare `psl-fact` (frontend/src/features/work-item/WorkItemOverview.tsx:70-76). Fixtures W-1711.json:83 and W-1706.json:84 set the detail but no tone. Fix: an optional per-fact tone in `presentation.facts` (PROPOSAL), mapped to the existing `psl-fact--current` / attention classes. This is also part of the awaiting-reconciliation gap that D-31 says must be F-09's panel only.

The processing desktop board draws the next-step line "No person needs to act yet. An agent drafting is not a review or an approval." in small text under the columns (board y≈827). The page hides it (`work-sr`). D-41 removes the next-step block only where a board does not draw it. Exception 20 ("NextStep markup may not change") no longer applies: round 2 already wraps NextStep in `work-sr`. Expected: render that line visibly as the board places it, as plain small print (12px, `--ink-muted`, like `.work-note`). Path: WorkItemOverview.tsx (NextStep wrapper); board SCR-02-desktop-processing.

"See all exceptions": the effect-uncertain desktop board draws it as a full-width secondary button in the AWAITING RECONCILIATION panel, between the facts and the small print. The page has no such button. The round-2 "F-06 slot" sits inside `NextStep`, which is now inside `work-sr`. F-06 is merged on the base (D-43), so once this branch takes dlv-00 the link will be invisible but still focusable: a hidden tab stop, and the board's button still missing. Expected per D-41: the link shows where the board draws it (panel links, `psl-btn psl-btn--secondary psl-btn--lg`), and no focusable control sits inside visually hidden text. Merge dlv-00, place F-06's link visibly, and re-score effect-uncertain at both widths. Exception 19 then becomes unused.

Phone history filter bar: the page draws four segments (All 7 · Decisions 2 · Agent work 2 · Evidence 1) in 358px. The labels are crammed against their borders: "Agent work" touches the Decisions divider, and the count chips nearly meet. SCR-02-mobile-history draws three equal segments: All 7 · Decisions 2 · Agents 2. Build.md says the phone uses the phone boards' wording, but this control does not. Expected: the phone board's three segments and the label "Agents" below 720px. The Evidence filter stays on desktop, or else it scrolls or wraps without crowding. Path: frontend/src/features/work-item/WorkItemHistory.tsx (filter tabs); side-by-side in fidelity-review/SCR-02-mobile-history-390.

Owner-needed desktop: SCR-02-desktop-owner-needed draws the held station (04 Finance review · "Held · no reviewer") as a filled red (#C8401C) box with white text, the same fill the default board uses for the current station. The page draws it as a white box with red #9A2F10 text (report: "text colour #FFFFFF on the board, #9A2F10 on the page" for "04", "Finance review", "Held · no reviewer"). Expected: the held station takes the same filled current-station class on this board. Path: StationTrack (WorkItemOverview.tsx ~line 100) / fixture W-1708 presentation.
